fusion.reason: PR 1263 already subsumes positive engine admission, exact engine artifact binding, causal event identity, route-policy identity, route identity and downstream inference echo. PR 1363 contains useful Typed Entry and GRID10 primitives but must not retain a competing route-binding authority.

new_material_finding.observation: PR 1363 current ingress identity payload includes received_at_ns, permissions, capability_scope, resource_budget and payload_ref in the same ingress_id used as route/event identity input.
new_material_finding.risk: A transport replay of the same causal event can acquire a different causal identity merely because arrival metadata, reference, permissions or budget changed.

required_split.event_sha256: H(schema, causal_id, generation, source, provenance, modality, observed_at, immutable payload_sha256, stable parent/stream semantics if admitted)
required_split.admission_identity: H(event_sha256, concrete ingress/arrival identity, received_at, payload_ref, permissions, capability_scope, resource_budget)

new_material_finding.hcu_route_consumes: event_sha256 plus PR1263 router-policy and admitted-engine/result identity
new_material_finding.audit_keeps: separate admission identity for transport, permissions, budget and replay accounting

hypothesis: Separating replay-stable causal event identity from concrete admission identity prevents transport metadata from redefining HCU causal reality while preserving exact audit and permission/budget provenance.
counterhypothesis: A single ingress hash containing both event and admission metadata is sufficient because every delivery should be treated as a distinct event.
cheapest_discriminator: Replay identical payload/provenance/observed event with a different received_at and payload_ref: event_sha256 must remain identical, admission identity must change; then change payload_sha256: both identities must change.

unusual_experiment.note: No second unusual experiment was executed after observing concurrent route-identity work.

next_exact_gate: Rebase/fuse PR 1363 to current EntityOS/HCU authority, split event and admission identity, remove/defer duplicate route-binding semantics in favor of PR 1263, then run exact Entry+HCU route+GRID10 replay/stale-generation regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated sandbox.
